name: prevent-breaking-openmrs-api
description: Check API contract compliance before modifying OpenMRS integration

checks.name: Concept UUID Stability
checks.description: Ensure concept UUIDs are not modified after production deployment

pattern.message: Changing concept UUIDs may break OpenMRS data integrity. Verify this change is intentional.

checks.name: Encounter Type Compatibility
checks.description: Ensure encounter structure remains compatible with OpenMRS REST API
checks.message: Encounter payload missing required fields. See OpenMRS REST API documentation.

checks.name: Observation Structure
checks.message: Observation missing required fields (concept, value, obsDatetime)

checks.name: Field Removal
checks.description: Removing fields may break existing code
checks.message: Removing fields breaks backward compatibility. Use deprecation strategy instead.

checks.name: Field Renaming
checks.description: Renaming fields may break existing code
checks.message: Renaming fields may break compatibility. Consider adding new field and deprecating old one.

checks.name: Type Changes
checks.description: Changing field types may break existing code
checks.message: Changing field types breaks compatibility. Create new field with new type instead.

integrationTests: Test encounter creation with valid payload
Test encounter creation with missing required fields
Test observation creation for each datatype (Numeric, Coded, Text, Boolean, Date)
Test error handling for API failures (400, 401, 404, 409, 500)

details: This change may break OpenMRS integration.
Review the API contract requirements above.
Ensure all required fields are present.
actions: Update API documentation if contract changed
